nodes.name: h3-spot-audit-pre-a-addendum.md
nodes.summary: Addendum to the GEPA Phase-1 H3 corpus pre-A audit report, documenting Option B retry execution, resume-bug recovery, texture audit methodology and quantitative/qualitative delta analysis, drift assessment, PM ratification verdict, and final cost reconciliation for the corpus generation phase.

nodes.name: h3-spot-audit-pre-a-report.md
nodes.summary: Primary GEPA Phase-1 H3 corpus quality audit report covering generation summary, failed cells, per-family/persona/company-stage coverage analysis, spot-audit results, cost reconciliation, and PM ratification ask for the pre-A halt decision.

nodes.name: texture-audit-side-by-side.md
nodes.summary: Side-by-side texture comparison of RETRY (JSON-mode) versus ORIGINAL-SAMPLE (seed=99) benchmark corpus entries across H3 task families F1-F5, personas (CFO, Founder/CEO, COO, VP Finance), and company stages (Series B growth, post-profitable consolidation), used to assess output quality drift between generation runs.
